request.hypothesis: If one pod of checkoutservice fails, the system will route requests to other pods (so the error rate might be low) but the checkout journey might be temporarily blocked. Expected: low error rate (10-20%) and slightly higher p95 latency.
request.reason: checkoutservice is critical for the checkout journey (the most important for revenue) and we have run service-down on it but not pod-kill.
